purpose: Machine-readable implementation and paper-revision plan derived from the comprehensive literature review.

defensible_novelty: Principal-identity provenance interpreted through an existing organizational access-control system
Authority attenuation as the meet of influencing principals' parameterized permissions
Role-sensitive per-argument Principal Context with separate authorization, visibility, and consent
Bounded explicit-state verification of agent reference monitors
claims_to_avoid: Proves information exfiltration impossible without an observer/noninterference model
SLED exhaustively proves unbounded implementation security
No new policies or semantic adapters are required
Maximal utility outside the strict authorization objective and task model

priority_tasks.title: Rebuild related-work taxonomy
instructions: Replace the model/system/evaluation-only taxonomy with mechanism-based subsections.
Add FIDES, Progent, Conseca, FORGE, SEAgent, PACT, ARGUS, AgentArmor, AgentPI, AgentDyn, AutoDojo, and AgentSecBench.
For each closest work, state its trusted components, enforcement granularity, policy source, and exact difference from Conflux.
Remove unsupported first-of-kind claims.
acceptance_criteria: PACT and SEAgent each receive a dedicated comparison paragraph.
The paper cites Biba, reference monitors, decentralized IFC, capabilities, provenance, and model checking.
Every novelty claim is scoped against a named closest work.

priority_tasks.title: Specify the trusted computing base
instructions: Enumerate reference monitor, provenance adapters, action schemas, ACS/PDP, delegation verifier, and decision composition as trusted components.
State fail-closed behavior for missing provenance, unknown actions, unavailable policy decisions, and invalid attestations.
State that the LLM and optional classifiers are not trusted to grant authority.
acceptance_criteria: A TCB table appears in the paper and docs.
Every theorem assumption maps to a concrete interface or invariant.
Unknown provenance cannot increase authority.

priority_tasks.title: Introduce parameterized effects
instructions: Replace atomic action strings with operation, resource, arguments, environment, observers, and effect class.
Define the ACS interface as authorize(principal, effect, context).
Bind authorization decisions to the exact serialized effect to avoid TOCTOU.
acceptance_criteria: Email recipient and body have separate paths.
File path and content have separate paths.
Shell command and non-authority-bearing content are distinguishable.
Policy version and effect hash are recorded.

priority_tasks.title: Implement role-sensitive argument provenance
instructions: Add per-value and per-argument provenance labels.
Support argument roles target, command, credential, selector, control, and content.
Use the full execution provenance as the conservative fallback when a narrower dependency is not trusted.
Do not permit the LLM to remove a source from provenance solely by assertion.
acceptance_criteria: A webpage-derived email body can be sent to a user-derived authorized recipient.
A webpage-derived recipient is blocked without delegation.
Unknown argument roles fail closed.
The paper proves argument-level non-escalation under sound provenance.

priority_tasks.title: Formalize scoped delegation
instructions: Represent delegation as an authenticated attenuating capability.
Include issuer, beneficiary/bearer constraints, operation, resource, arguments, purpose, observers, expiry, use count, transitivity, and revocation.
Make authority increase possible only through a validated delegation transition.
acceptance_criteria: Delegated authority is a subset of issuer authority.
Subdelegation can only attenuate.
Replay, expiry, revocation, and widening tests exist.
Audit records identify the consumed capability.

priority_tasks.title: Define the provenance adapter contract
instructions: Require adapters to label every returned field with principals, entities, activities, precision, and attestation status.
Require all narrowing operations to be trusted and explicit.
Represent unknown or unverifiable provenance conservatively.
Identify observers and effect sinks.
acceptance_criteria: Forged, omitted, stale, and contradictory provenance tests fail closed.
A trusted parser is distinguished from the author of parsed content.
Cross-process provenance can be authenticated or verified.

priority_tasks.title: Prove complete mediation operationally
instructions: Create an effect-boundary inventory for every external side effect.
Test nested calls, direct SDK paths, retries, callbacks, background tasks, and alternate transports.
Route all effects through one reference-monitor interface.
acceptance_criteria: Every effect type maps to a monitor entry point.
Bypass attempts are covered by tests.
Monitor decisions are bound atomically to executed parameters.

priority_tasks.title: Recast SLED as bounded explicit-state verification
instructions: Specify state, transition, terminal, observation, and property semantics.
Report finite bounds and proposal vocabulary explicitly.
Add state canonicalization, unique-state counts, transition counts, and minimal counterexamples.
Do not exclude prefix safety violations because a task later reaches a depth bound.
acceptance_criteria: The paper uses bounded/exhaustive-within-model wording.
Security and task-completion metrics treat truncated traces separately.
Counterexample traces are deterministic and serializable.

priority_tasks.title: Add monitor mutation testing
instructions: Create mutants for omitted influence, permission union, stale ACS, skipped nested propagation, unknown-provenance allow, observer omission, and delegation replay.
Run SLED against every mutant and minimize the first counterexample.
acceptance_criteria: Every seeded security mutant is killed.
The correct monitor passes the same properties and bounds.
The oracle is implemented separately from the monitor logic.

priority_tasks.title: Separate security verification from empirical utility
instructions: Use nondeterministic/worst-case model outputs for invariant checking.
Use real models for task completion, proposal quality, and attack interference.
Report block, allow, ask, provenance-unknown, and delegation-use rates.
acceptance_criteria: No security metric improves because the model refuses an attack.
No maximal-utility claim is based only on the authorization predicate.
Model, monitor, and adapter failures are reported separately.

priority_tasks.title: Add provenance overlays to external benchmarks
instructions: Annotate AgentDojo first with principals, resources, writers/readers, observers, and argument roles.
Add one context-dependent benchmark such as AgentPI or AgentDyn.
Include mixed-trust tasks that distinguish flat execution provenance from argument provenance.
acceptance_criteria: At least one benchmark adapter is reproducible end to end.
Annotations are stored separately from upstream benchmark code.
Flat ITES and role-sensitive Principal Context are compared.

priority_tasks.title: Integrate a real policy decision point
instructions: Implement a parameterized adapter for Cedar, OpenFGA, or OPA/Rego.
Retain the in-memory ACS for proofs and unit tests.
Record policy version and decision evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Resource- and argument-sensitive authorization works end to end.
Revocation is reflected at action time.
Adapter errors fail closed.

priority_tasks.title: Separate authorization, visibility, consent, and safety
instructions: Introduce typed component decisions and deterministic final composition.
Treat generated intent policies as restrictions, never grants of ACS authority.
Model Ask as issuance of a scoped consent, delegation, or declassification grant.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover authorized-but-no-consent, authorized-but-confidential, safe-but-unauthorized, and delegated cases.
The paper no longer conflates authorization with alignment.

priority_tasks.title: Maintain a claim-evidence ledger
instructions: Create one record per major claim with assumptions, proof/test/benchmark evidence, limitations, and citations.
Link records to code, experiment outputs, and paper sections.
acceptance_criteria: Every abstract and conclusion claim maps to evidence.
Codex can identify the exact files and experiments that support each claim.
Unverified and planned claims are visibly marked.

recommended_experiments.question: Does argument-level principal provenance recover mixed-trust utility without sacrificing authorization security?
Can caveated delegation support action-open tasks while retaining attenuation?
What is the security-utility-cost frontier across provenance precision levels?
Does SLED detect representative monitor and adapter bugs?
Can adaptive attacks exploit provenance inference, role synthesis, approvals, or mediation gaps?

closest_work_priority.reason: Directly exposes flat provenance granularity and provides argument-level contracts.
Uses privilege escalation as the organizing security objective and covers multi-agent confused deputies.
Closest classical information-flow-control formulation with separate confidentiality and integrity.
Canonical system-level prompt-injection architecture and common AgentDojo baseline.
Strong policy/reference-monitor/observability architecture with multi-agent history.
Causal and argument-level evidence provenance for context-dependent tasks.
Programmable privilege constraints and proxy deployment.
Contextual task policy generation and deterministic enforcement.
